skill.name: plot-consistency-checker
skill.description: Reviews plot summaries, outlines, character arcs, and world rules for contradictions, plot holes, pacing problems, and weak narrative logic.
skill.summary: Find plot inconsistencies and receive clear, practical revision suggestions.
skill.author: Amraha-Anwar

security_audit.summary: The prompt-only SKILL.md contains narrative review instructions without executable code, network access, secret handling, or privilege requests. No static or semantic security findings were identified, including prompt injection language.

content.user_title: Check Plot Consistency and Repair Story Logic
content.value_statement: Plot contradictions and weak transitions can disrupt reader trust. This skill reviews story materials and proposes focused fixes in a clear table.
actual_capabilities: Requests missing plot summaries, chapter outlines, character arcs, and world rules before analysis.
Checks cause and effect, character motivations, timelines, and event continuity.
Tests story events against stated magic, technology, political, and other world rules.
Identifies plot holes, unexplained coincidences, missing transitions, inconsistent behavior, and pacing problems.
Explains each issue and proposes a correction, with an optional rewrite when useful.
Presents findings in an Issue, Explanation, and Proposed Fix table.
limitations: Results depend on the completeness and accuracy of the supplied story materials.
The skill cannot confirm author intent when motivations or world rules are missing.
Suggested rewrites may change the intended voice and require author review.
The review focuses on narrative consistency, not grammar, copyediting, or publication readiness.

use_cases.title: Revise a Novel Outline
use_cases.description: Check chapter events, character choices, and pacing before drafting or revising a novel.

use_cases.title: Validate a Screenplay Sequence
use_cases.description: Review a scene list for missing transitions, weak causes, and inconsistent character behavior.

use_cases.title: Assess Story Continuity
use_cases.description: Compare plot materials and world rules to prepare focused developmental feedback.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Plot Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this plot summary for contradictions, plot holes, and unclear causes. Present each finding with an explanation and proposed fix: [plot summary]
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner wants a focused review of a short story concept.

prompt_templates.title: Review Timeline and Motivation
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this outline with these character arcs. Find timeline conflicts and actions that do not match stated motivations: [outline] [character arcs]
prompt_templates.scenario: A writer has an outline and defined character goals.

prompt_templates.title: Audit World Rules and Pacing
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these scenes against the stated world rules. Identify broken rules, unexplained coincidences, missing transitions, and pacing problems: [scenes] [world rules]
prompt_templates.scenario: A speculative fiction writer needs continuity and pacing feedback.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Full Consistency Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the summary, chapter outline, character arcs, and world rules together. Explain every inconsistency and suggest the smallest effective correction: [materials]
prompt_templates.scenario: An editor needs a detailed review across several planning documents.

output_examples.input: Mara cannot read the ancient script in chapter two, but translates it without explanation in chapter five.
output_examples.output: Issue: Unexplained ability. Explanation: Mara gains translation skill without setup. Proposed Fix: Add training, a translation tool, or another qualified character.

output_examples.input: The outline states that travel takes three days, but the hero reaches the capital on the same evening.
output_examples.output: Issue: Timeline conflict. Explanation: The journey breaks the established travel time. Proposed Fix: Extend the timeline or establish faster transportation.

output_examples.input: A cautious detective enters the suspect's house alone without urgency or preparation.
output_examples.output: Issue: Inconsistent behavior. Explanation: The action conflicts with the detective's established caution. Proposed Fix: Add urgent stakes or show a deliberate safety plan.

best_practices: Provide a complete plot summary and a clearly ordered scene or chapter list.
State character goals, timeline constraints, and world rules before requesting the review.
Evaluate proposed fixes against the intended theme, tone, and future plot developments.
anti_patterns: Do not submit isolated scenes without explaining their place in the wider plot.
Do not omit intentional mysteries that could appear to be plot holes.
Do not accept every rewrite without checking voice, theme, and later consequences.

faq.question: What materials should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a plot summary, ordered outline, character arcs, and relevant world rules. Partial materials can produce a narrower review.

faq.question: Can it review a full manuscript?
faq.answer: It is designed around summaries, outlines, scene lists, arcs, and rules. Large manuscripts may need division into smaller sections.

faq.question: Does it rewrite weak sections?
faq.answer: It can provide an optional rewrite for an affected section. Review the result for voice and intended meaning.

faq.question: Can it check fantasy or science fiction rules?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply the relevant magic, technology, political, or social rules so events can be checked against them.

faq.question: How are findings presented?
faq.answer: The skill uses a table with Issue, Explanation, and Proposed Fix columns.

faq.question: Will every unusual event be marked as an error?
faq.answer: No. Explain intentional mysteries, coincidences, and unreliable narration so the review can distinguish them from inconsistencies.
